{{Youmay|senior [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] flag ranks|the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] position of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]]}}
The rank of '''Admiral of the Fleet''' was held by naval commanders at several points in history.

==History==
The commander of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] held this rank during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Unidentified Admiral of the Fleet|The Admiral]] was based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The position was possibly the head of the [[Admiralty (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Admiralty]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the rank was borne by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], denoting his position as senior [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] and [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the Fleet under the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="RASBse">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>

When the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Sien Sovv]] replaced Ackbar as Supreme Commander in around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], he adopted the title '''[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]]''' instead. By [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the title had also been awarded to at least one other senior flag officer, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Admiral [[Traest Kre'fey]].<ref name="Ye">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref> New Republic Fleet Admirals were apparently distinguished by having the hulls of their [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] painted pure white.
